answer_1.quote: We describe ImageInWords (IIW), a human-in-the-loop framework for curating hyperdetailed image descriptions, and its resulting annotations.

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU, ROUGE, CIDEr, BERTScore, and BLEURT in Appendix D.5 but look to human SxS for more accurate judgements.

answer_4.quote: We assess quality with human side-by-side (SxS) comparisons to human-written datasets (DCI, DOCCI) and GPT-4V.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation is done on a 5 point scale defined using "substantially better" (+ +) or "marginally better" (+) ratings on both sides of a "neutral" (-).
